stories.title: Los jesuitas expulsan al sacerdote Francesc Peris por abusos sexuales a menores

en.title: Jesuits expel priest Francesc Peris for sexual abuse of minors
en.summary: The Jesuit order has expelled a priest after a canonical process found him guilty of crimes against minors spanning over 50 years.

stories.title: La Diputación Permanente votará los decretos de vivienda: PP, Vox y Junts, sin mayoría

en.title: Permanent Committee to vote on housing decrees: PP, Vox and Junts lack majority
en.summary: Housing decrees rejected by Congress will be resubmitted for validation to the Permanent Committee instead of the full chamber, altering parliamentary majorities in a way that removes the PP, Vox and Junts coalition's absolute majority.

stories.title: Medvedev, expulsado del torneo de Pekín por un pelotazo a un espectador

en.title: Medvedev expelled from Beijing tournament for hitting ball at spectator
en.summary: Tennis player Daniil Medvedev was immediately disqualified from the Beijing ATP 500 tournament after hitting a ball that struck a spectator in the head during his match against Novak Djokovic.

stories.title: Los jesuitas expulsan al sacerdote Francesc Peris por abusar de menores desde los años 70

en.title: Jesuits expel priest Francesc Peris for abusing minors since the 1970s
en.summary: The Society of Jesus has expelled an 84-year-old priest from the clerical state and religious order after finding him guilty of sexual abuse against minors since the 1970s, following a canonical process initiated in 2023.

stories.title: Sánchez convoca elecciones generales el 29 de noviembre

en.title: Sánchez calls general elections for November 29
en.summary: Spanish President Pedro Sánchez has dissolved parliament and called early general elections for November 29. He informed King Felipe VI of the decision following consultations with socialist party officials and other political leaders.

stories.title: Detenido un hombre por asesinar a sus padres con una mancuerna en el piso familiar

en.title: Man arrested for killing his parents with a dumbbell in family home
en.summary: A 36-year-old man has been detained after his parents, both around 75 years old, were found dead in their Madrid home after being struck with a dumbbell early morning. Police responded after a call requesting help was made around 4 AM.

stories.title: Los jesuitas expulsan del sacerdocio a un pederasta que abusó de menores en España y Bolivia a lo largo de 30 años

en.title: Jesuits expel priest from priesthood for abusing minors in Spain and Bolivia over 30 years
en.summary: Francesc Peris has been removed from the priesthood after being accused of abusing at least 22 children between 1974 and 2005. All offenses have reached the statute of limitations for criminal prosecution.

stories.title: Sánchez adelanta las elecciones al 29 de noviembre

en.title: Sánchez moves forward elections to November 29
en.summary: The Spanish government scheduled early general elections for November 29. The Council of Ministers approved modified housing decrees that require validation by the Permanent Deputation.

stories.title: César, el ingeniero que ha matado en Madrid a sus padres con una mancuerna, ya fue detenido en Badajoz tras amenazar con un cuchillo a familiares y vecinos

en.title: César, the engineer who killed his parents in Madrid with a dumbbell, was previously detained in Badajoz for threatening family and neighbors with a knife
en.summary: César, the man accused of killing his parents with a dumbbell in Madrid, had prior criminal involvement. He was previously arrested in Badajoz for threatening relatives and neighbors with a knife.

stories.title: Los jesuitas expulsan al sacerdote Francesc Peris por abusar de más de una veintena de menores

en.title: Jesuits expel priest Francesc Peris for abusing more than twenty minors
en.summary: The Jesuit order has expelled priest Francesc Peris, who is accused of abusing at least 24 minors between the 1970s and 2005. The alleged offenses have passed the statute of limitations for criminal prosecution.

stories.title: Sánchez adelanta las elecciones al 29 de noviembre: “Necesitamos una mayoría progresista mucho más amplia”

en.title: Sánchez advances elections to November 29: "We need a much broader progressive majority"
en.summary: President Sánchez has moved forward the general elections to November 29, citing the need for a broader progressive majority. He reviewed achievements of the left-wing coalition government.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez adelanta las elecciones generales al 29 de noviembre

en.title: Pedro Sánchez advances general elections to November 29
en.summary: President Sánchez has ended the parliamentary term and called early elections for November 29 following the defeat of housing decrees and large-scale mobilizations.

stories.title: Neinor reducirá a la mitad su deuda con hasta 15.000 viviendas entregadas en los próximos dos años

en.title: Neinor will halve its debt with up to 15,000 homes delivered in the next two years
en.summary: Spanish property developer Neinor plans to deliver up to 15,000 homes over the next two years to reduce its debt by half. The company projects net profits of up to 170 million euros for 2028 and aims for stable dividends over three years.

stories.title: La banca ante un eventual cambio de Gobierno: ¿alivio fiscal a la vista?

en.title: Banks face potential government change: fiscal relief in sight?
en.summary: Early elections have prompted debate about how a change in government could affect the domestic banking sector. The discussion centers on possible tax relief implications for banks.

stories.title: La dinastía Bolsonaro en Brasil acaricia un sorprendente regreso

en.title: The Bolsonaro dynasty in Brazil eyes a surprising return
en.summary: First-round election results increase the possibility of a spectacular victory for Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the former Brazilian president.

stories.title: Las promotoras del Golfo apuestan por el próximo destino en el Mediterráneo

en.title: Gulf developers bet on next Mediterranean destination
en.summary: Sovereign wealth funds from Abu Dhabi and Qatar are among investors directing billions of dollars toward Egypt's northern coast.

stories.title: Feijóo promete a la empresa familiar bajar los impuestos y deflactar el IRPF si gobierna

en.title: Feijóo promises family businesses tax cuts and IRPF deflation if he governs
en.summary: The politician pledges tax relief measures and proposes housing law reforms to strengthen property owner protections and legal security.
